Declined the auditor's 'cocksuckers / fairies' at 57.1 and 57.10: catamite is the corpus-wide plain rendering of cinaedus (batch-01 and batch-03 revisions included) and 'cocksucker' names a different act; reasons put in the notes, no WRONG verdict in this batch.
